title: Fribourg storm past Neuchatel to claim SBL title
description: Neuchatel - Fribourg 56-94 Fribourg claimed SBL title. They coasted past Neuchatel on the road in Game 3 of the championship series to conquer the trophy. The game without a history. Fribourg led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. 25 personal fouls committed by Neuchatel helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was Montenegrin forward Slobodan Miljanic (199-1990, college: Lynn) who scored 27 points. The former international forward Natan Jurkovitz (202-1995) chipped in 10 points and 9 rebounds. Four Fribourg players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was international forward Killian Martin (204-1998) who recorded 14 points and American center Daniel Giddens (213-1997, college: Vermont)…
